article.title: An Israeli settler and a Palestinian driver killed in West Bank shootings
article.summary: An Israeli settler has been fatally shot in the occupied West Bank, while Israel's military said it killed a man who attempted to ram his vehicle into troops elsewhere in the Palestinian territory. The news came as violence in the West Bank is escalating at a very rapid pace. “All Israeli military authorities involved with the West Bank have been warning the Israeli government that the situation is basically out of control”, explains FRANCE 24 correspondent Noga Tarnopolsky.

article.title: Israeli forces detain 27 Palestinians in raid on West Bank village, Wafa reports
article.summary: Israeli forces detain 27 Palestinians in raid on West Bank village, Wafa reportsIsraeli forces have detained at least 27 Palestinians in a raid on the village of al-Mughayyir, east of Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported.Local sources told Wafa that Israeli infantry units were deployed throughout the village early on Sunday morning and its only entrance was closed.Soldiers then raided several homes, ransacked their contents, and stole cash and gold jewellery, the agency said.The detainees are being held at the home of Shaher Sari Abu Alia, according to Wafa.The search and arrest campaign in al-Mughayyir follows an attack by Israeli settlers and forces on Saturday, the agency added.

article.title: Israeli forces raid West Bank shooting suspect's hometown, besiege mosque
article.summary: Israeli forces raid West Bank shooting suspect's hometown, besiege mosqueA large Israeli force raided Biddu, the hometown of the Palestinian accused of carrying out the shooting at the illegal Neveh Tzuf settlement north of Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, according to an Al Jazeera report.Israeli soldiers also besieged worshippers at a mosque during afternoon prayers.Israel Army Radio identified the shooting suspect as a 37-year-old “Hamas activist” from Biddu who reportedly scouted the site a day earlier before opening fire alone and fleeing the scene.The suspect had been arrested following a pursuit, apprehended by soldiers after he fled to a hospital near the attack site, Israeli military said.National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir said the attack was the first case meeting the criteria for Israel's "death penalty law for terrorists," calling the sentence "mandatory" since the alleged perpetrator survived, a law passed by parliament that applies only to Palestinians and h...

article.title: Two Palestinian men injured in West Bank settler attack
article.summary: Two Palestinian men injured in West Bank settler attackTwo Palestinians were injured in an attack by Israeli settlers on Sunday east of the town of Salfit in the central occupied West Bank, Wafa reported.The Palestinian Red Crescent said its crews treated two Palestinians injured in the attack: a 58-year-old man who sustained a head injury after being struck with a stone, and another who was stabbed in the thigh.The Red Crescent provided first aid to both injured Palestinians and transferred them to Salfit Governmental Hospital, Wafa reported.
